architectureSummary.systemRole: Temporal is an open-source, highly scalable durable execution platform guaranteeing reliable workflow execution across distributed infrastructure.

coreSubsystems.name: Frontend Service
coreSubsystems.role: Stateless gRPC API gateway handling routing, authorization, and rate limiting.

coreSubsystems.name: History Service
coreSubsystems.role: Stateful core maintaining workflow state machines, mutable state caching, shard lease fencing, and outbox task generation.

coreSubsystems.name: Matching Service
coreSubsystems.role: Task queue matching engine coordinating synchronous and asynchronous worker dispatch.

coreSubsystems.name: System Worker
coreSubsystems.role: Background workers executing parent close policies, batch operations, and system maintenance.

coreSubsystems.name: Persistence Layer
coreSubsystems.role: Pluggable relational/NoSQL storage layer with optimistic concurrency control.
